what_it_shows: About 21,000 offshore packages (2026 season), 60 sampled at random: 3 released before the IRC 7216 consent was signed and 4 holding unmasked partner SSNs on Schedules K-1; about 9,800 lender releases, 25 sampled, each with a signed consent before release and a copy sent to the client; about 380,000 electronic Forms 8879, 25 sampled, each with identity verification before signature

title: Gap analysis samples: incident records and former-client folders
source_system: SOC case management; DMS and legacy archive retention data
what_it_shows: 388 security incidents (2026-01 to 2026-06), 25 sampled at random, each with records for every phase; 60 former-client folders sampled at random, 44 past the 7-year schedule

title: Gap analysis contract review: business associate agreements and federal subcontracts
source_system: Contract management system
what_it_shows: All about 240 business associate agreements reviewed: 22 on legacy templates; all 19 subcontracts under federal contracts reviewed: 4 without the FAR 52.204-21 flow-down clause

title: External TLS scan of tier-1 endpoints
source_system: Scanner run by Security Operations for the GRC team
what_it_shows: 38 external endpoints of tier-1 systems scanned; the legacy SL-2 file transfer endpoint accepts outdated cipher suites; the other 37 accept current TLS versions and cipher suites only

title: AI portfolio review: inventory, review records and IRC 7216 memos
source_system: AI governance committee portfolio review meeting (2026-08-26) and committee site
what_it_shows: 12 use cases in the inventory: 8 with committee review (AI-011 reviewed 2026-07-22 and on hold) and 4 not reviewed (AI-004, AI-007, AI-010, AI-012); 9 touch tax return information, 5 of them with a counsel memo on the IRC 7216 basis; AI-010 ranking disabled 2026-08-14; public generative AI domains blocked at the web gateway since 2026-08-10; the tax software AI drafting suggestions disabled 2026-08-25; since 2026-06-01 procurement and change management block AI features without an inventory ID

title: AI-005 group-level testing results, 2026-06
source_system: Data science files
what_it_shows: AI-005 holds bank account changes for ITIN filers 2.1 times as often as the overall rate

title: AI vendor terms and AI-001 red-team test review
source_system: AI service contracts; audit platform agreement; red-team test report (2026-06)
what_it_shows: AI model provider terms for AI-001: U.S.-only processing, no training, no human review of content and deletion after 30 days; the audit platform agreement has no business associate terms covering the vendor's model service used by AI-007; the 2026-06 red-team test of 40 crafted documents changed 0 extracted fields and altered 3 summaries

title: Web gateway policy change record
source_system: Web gateway; IT service management change record
what_it_shows: The public generative AI category is blocked at the web gateway from 2026-08-10; the approved enterprise assistant stays reachable

title: Control assessment: Account management samples
source_system: Identity governance workflows; TEP account export; HR termination records; Director of Tax Technology interview (60 account events, 60 seasonal terminations, 12 privileged groups)
what_it_shows: 60 sampled account events matched approved requests and role templates; 4 of 60 sampled seasonal terminations were disabled 2 to 9 business days after the end date, which had not been entered at hire; end dates are optional in the seasonal hiring workflow; 3 orphaned service accounts with no owner in the tax application database; 2 of 12 quarterly privileged group certifications not completed in Q2 2026

title: Control assessment: Inactive account analytic
source_system: Identity governance and client portal account data (about 6,300 workforce TEP accounts and about 760,000 client accounts)
what_it_shows: Workforce accounts are disabled after 45 days of inactivity; about 41,000 client portal accounts with no sign-in for more than 24 months were still enabled, and no inactivity rule exists for client accounts

title: Control assessment: DMS permission analytic and trace
source_system: DMS permission export; tax application role matrix (about 516,000 repositories; 60 traced)
what_it_shows: About 160,000 repositories (31%) grant access to the whole office tax team rather than the engagement team

title: Control assessment: Separation of duties test
source_system: Tax application role matrix and workflow configuration (58 roles); 3 test accounts
what_it_shows: Preparer, reviewer and e-file release duties are separated and enforced; test accounts could not self-review or release

title: Control assessment: Least privilege analytic
source_system: DMS permission export; PAM role catalog
what_it_shows: About 2,600 staff can open returns outside their engagements in the DMS

title: Control assessment: Remote access test
source_system: Zero-trust access policies; 3 remote access paths tested from an unmanaged device
what_it_shows: Remote access to the TEP was denied without device posture on all 3 paths; usage restrictions documented in STD-02.3

title: Control assessment: External system use test
source_system: Conditional access policies for email and firm applications; sign-in tests from an unmanaged personal device
what_it_shows: Browser access to email from an unmanaged personal device succeeded; terms for external systems are documented in STD-05.2

title: Control assessment: Offshore release sample
source_system: Offshore release workflow and consent records (about 21,000 packages; 60 sampled)
what_it_shows: Release staff cannot see in the workflow whether a signed IRC 7216 consent exists; 3 of 60 sampled packages were released before the consent was signed; consent and SSN masking are checked by hand, and 4 of 60 packages held unmasked SSNs on Schedules K-1

title: Control assessment: Training records and phishing results
source_system: Learning system records (60 sampled, 40 permanent and 20 seasonal); 6 months of phishing results
what_it_shows: Annual training delivered, with content updated for business email compromise and IRC 7216; 2 of 20 sampled seasonal staff received TEP access before completing initial training

title: Control assessment: Role-based training records
source_system: Role-based training plan and records for reviewers, e-file operations and administrators (about 1,900 role holders; 25 sampled)
what_it_shows: Administrator and SOC role-based training current; the 2026 refund diversion module for reviewers and e-file operations was not delivered; lessons from the two 2025 refund diversion attempts are not in role-based training

title: Control assessment: Event logging test
source_system: Event catalog and SIEM parsers; 6 event types generated in test
what_it_shows: Bank change, e-file release, bulk export, consent signing, administrator change and portal download events were all logged with the required fields

title: Control assessment: Audit review records
source_system: SOC weekly review records and detection content (26 weekly reviews; 5 sampled)
what_it_shows: Review evidence absent for 2 of 5 sampled weeks; reviews do not cover session token replay, and their scope was not changed after the 2025 rise in adversary-in-the-middle phishing; findings are reported to system owners through cases

title: Control assessment: Log archive protection test
source_system: Log archive settings; deletion attempt with an administrator test account
what_it_shows: Write-once settings in place; the deletion attempt was blocked and alerted

title: Control assessment: Log retention inspection
source_system: Retention settings
what_it_shows: Logs kept 1 year online and 7 years in the archive

title: Control assessment: Continuous monitoring review
source_system: Continuous monitoring strategy; 3 of 6 monthly metric packages
what_it_shows: Strategy, metrics and reporting to the CISO and the Audit and Risk Committee in place

title: Control assessment: Penetration test review
source_system: 2026-04 penetration test report and scoping memo
what_it_shows: Annual external and internal tests by an outside firm, scoped from the risk register; findings tracked

title: Control assessment: TEP change sample
source_system: Change records (186 TEP changes, 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30; 40 sampled)
what_it_shows: Changes were reviewed by the change advisory board and records retained; 7 of 40 sampled changes, including e-file and direct deposit field rules, were approved without a documented test result

title: Control assessment: Configuration settings test
source_system: Hardening baselines; all 12 TEP servers; 60 of about 140 processing hub printer-scanners
what_it_shows: Server settings match the baseline and drift is monitored daily; 14 of 60 sampled printer-scanners had default administrator settings, and the deviations were not recorded

title: Control assessment: Inventory trace
source_system: CMDB (about 4,900 TEP cloud resources; 60 traced)
what_it_shows: Inventory reviewed monthly with no duplicates; 11 of 60 traced resources had no owner tag; AI extraction pipeline components were not in the inventory

title: Control assessment: Contingency plan review
source_system: TEP contingency plan v3; interviews with the Director of Tax Technology and the Director of e-file Operations
what_it_shows: The plan identifies essential functions, objectives, roles and coordination with incident handling; it has no scenario for keeping e-filing going if the transmitter is down in peak season, and it was not updated for the transmitter concentration in the BIA or for the 2026-05-09 DR test result

title: Control assessment: DR test review
source_system: 2026-05-09 DR test plan, results and corrective actions
what_it_shows: The plan is tested annually; results reviewed; corrective action opened

title: Control assessment: Backup sample and restore observation
source_system: Backup job reports (4,344 hourly database jobs over 181 days; 25 sampled); 1 restore observed
what_it_shows: Sampled backups completed, encrypted and immutable; the observed restore succeeded

title: Control assessment: Recovery and reconstitution review
source_system: 2026-05-09 DR test report
what_it_shows: Tax workflow and e-file queue recovered in 9.5 hours against the 8-hour RTO; reconstitution to a known state verified by reconciliation

title: Control assessment: Sign-in sample
source_system: Sign-in logs (about 6,300 workforce TEP accounts; 25 sampled sign-ins)
what_it_shows: Unique identification and authentication for all 25 sampled sign-ins

title: Control assessment: Privileged MFA check
source_system: All 46 privileged TEP and database accounts
what_it_shows: All 46 privileged accounts use FIDO2 authenticators

title: Control assessment: Workforce authentication analytic
source_system: Authentication analytic for about 13,800 workforce accounts
what_it_shows: 9 service mailboxes accept legacy authentication without MFA; about 8,900 staff use push MFA with number matching

title: Control assessment: Authenticator and default credential tests
source_system: Authenticator policies; administrator interfaces of 60 of about 140 printer-scanners, tested with the Director of Endpoint Engineering's approval
what_it_shows: Password policy, breached-password checks and vault controls in place; 14 of 60 sampled printer-scanners accepted the default administrator password; scan-to-email account passwords are stored on the devices and readable from the administrator interface

title: Control assessment: Client authentication analytic
source_system: Client portal authentication data (about 760,000 client accounts)
what_it_shows: Client users are uniquely identified; about 274,000 individual client accounts authenticate with a password only

title: Control assessment: Identity proofing sample
source_system: Identity verification service records (about 380,000 electronic Forms 8879; 25 sampled)
what_it_shows: Identity evidence was collected, validated and verified before every sampled signature

title: Control assessment: Incident response testing review
source_system: Exercise records 2025 to 2026
what_it_shows: No test of the business email compromise and data theft runbook, including the Incident Disclosure Committee step, is recorded

title: Control assessment: Incident handling sample
source_system: Incident records (388 incidents, 2026-01 to 2026-06; 25 sampled plus all 9 at AF-05 and AF-06)
what_it_shows: Enterprise incidents were handled through all phases with lessons learned applied; AF-05 and AF-06 incidents were handled by their providers without SOC playbooks, and 3 of the 9 had no containment record

title: Control assessment: Incident reporting sample and staff interviews
source_system: Reporting metrics; 25 incidents; 20 staff interviews
what_it_shows: Staff knew how to report; required reports in the sampled incidents were made

title: Control assessment: Incident response plan review
source_system: Incident response plan, runbooks and notification matrix; interviews with the General Counsel, CISO and Chief Privacy Officer
what_it_shows: The plan follows the 314.4(h)(1)-(7) structure and is approved and distributed; contractual client notice terms (24 to 72 hours) are not tracked centrally; the plan has not been updated for state law changes since 2024-11 or for the AF-05 and AF-06 EFINs

title: Control assessment: Media sanitization sample
source_system: Certificates of destruction and drive wiping records (412 disposed devices, 2026-01 to 2026-06; 25 sampled)
what_it_shows: Every sampled device had a sanitization record

title: Control assessment: Termination sample
source_system: HR records and identity governance logs (same 60 seasonal terminations as EV-AC-2)
what_it_shows: Credentials revoked and property retrieved for permanent staff; 4 of 60 sampled seasonal terminations were disabled 2 to 9 business days late

title: Control assessment: Risk assessment review
source_system: 2026 enterprise risk assessment (P01 pass 1)
what_it_shows: The written assessment follows 314.4(b)(1), and results go to the Audit and Risk Committee

title: Control assessment: Vulnerability finding sample
source_system: Scan reports and remediation tickets (1,240 critical and high findings on TEP components; 60 sampled)
what_it_shows: Monthly authenticated scans and analysis in place; 6 of 60 sampled critical and high findings on portal components were past the 15-day target

title: Control assessment: External service review
source_system: Vendor register and contracts for 31 tier-1 and tier-2 TEP vendors, including the offshore provider; the 60 offshore packages in EV-AC-21
what_it_shows: Oversight roles defined in STD-01.3; the offshore provider received packages released before consent (3 of 60) or with unmasked SSNs (4 of 60); 9 of 31 vendors, including the identity verification service, were past their annual review date

title: Control assessment: Transmission protection scan
source_system: TLS scan of all 14 TEP external endpoints
what_it_shows: The legacy SL-2 file transfer endpoint accepts outdated cipher suites (exception EXC-2026-040); the other 13 endpoints accept current TLS only

title: Control assessment: Encryption at rest inspection
source_system: Database, storage and backup encryption settings
what_it_shows: All TEP stores encrypted with customer-managed keys

title: Control assessment: Patch sample
source_system: Patch records (318 patches, 2026-01 to 2026-06; 25 sampled)
what_it_shows: Flaws identified, reported and tested before installation; security updates for 2 of 25 sampled portal container images were installed after the 15-day target

title: Control assessment: Monitoring review and token replay test
source_system: SOC use cases; purple-team replay of a stolen session token against a test mailbox and test DMS folder
what_it_shows: Attack indicators and unauthorized connections are monitored 24x7 and events analyzed; the replayed session token gave access to the test mailbox and DMS folder for 3 days without an alert; bulk export monitoring was not adjusted by role after the 2025 threat change

title: Control assessment: Mail filtering test
source_system: Mail filtering policies; 10 test messages (lookalike domain, external tag, forwarding)
what_it_shows: Filters detected and acted on all 10 test messages at entry and exit points

title: Control assessment: Retention sample
source_system: Records schedule and DMS retention data (60 former-client folders)
what_it_shows: Returns and consents managed per policy; 44 of 60 sampled former-client folders were past the 7-year schedule, and no disposal run has been executed
